description_en: Recommends the optimal cluster capacity planning configuration based on business scenarios, QPS, and log generation volume
description_zh: 用于系统根据业务场景、QPS和日志产生量等情况为您推荐集群容量规划的最佳配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch capacity-plan --complex-query-available true --data-info unit=MiB code=totalRawData size=100 type=hot totalCount=10000 --metric code=write responseTime=100 concurrent=2 peakQps=30 throughput=100 averageQps=30 type=common --usage-scenario general --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CapacityPlan

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether complex aggregation query is required. Valid values:

true: Required.
false (default): Not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否具有复杂聚合查询的需求。可选值：

true：是
false（默认）：否
parameters.name: complex_query_available

fields.help_en:
The disk data metric code. Valid values:

totalRawData: source data information
document: data document information, estimated number of documents
dailyIncrement: daily data growth
dailyIncrement: daily incremental documents
retentionTime: data retention period
replica: replica settings
fields.help_zh:
磁盘数据指标代码。可选值：

totalRawData：源数据信息
document：数据文档信息，预估文档数
dailyIncrement：数据每日增长量
dailyIncrement：每日增量文档数
retentionTime：数据保留时长
replica：副本设置
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The metric value of disk usage
fields.help_zh: 磁盘使用情况指标数值
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The total number of data entries
fields.name: total_count

fields.help_en:
The disk data type. Valid values:

hot: hot data
warm: warm data
fields.help_zh:
磁盘数据类型，可选值：

hot：热数据
warm：冷数据
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The data unit or time unit. Valid values:

Data units: MiB, GiB, TB, PB
Time units: DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, YEARS
fields.help_zh:
数据单位或时间单位，可选值：

数据单位：MiB、GiB、TB、PB
时间单位：DAYS、WEEKS、MONTHS、YEARS
fields.name: unit

fields.help_en:
The search or write metric code. Valid values:

write: write
search: search
fields.help_zh:
搜索或写入指标代码。可选值：

write：写入
search：搜索
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The expected average response time, in milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 期望平均响应时间，单位：毫秒
fields.name: response_time

fields.help_en:
The search or write peak type. Valid values:

common: normal
peak: peak
fields.help_zh:
搜索/写入峰值类型。可选值：

common：常规
peak：高峰
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The metric information for disk usage, search and write operations, and aggregation requests
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘使用情况、搜索和写入情况、聚合请求等指标信息
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:
Scenarios. Valid values:

general: general-purpose scenario
analysisVisualization: data analytics scenario
dbAcceleration: database acceleration scenario
search: search scenario
log: log scenario
parameters.help_zh:
使用场景，可选值：

general：通用场景
analysisVisualization：数据分析场景
dbAcceleration：数据库加速场景
search：搜索场景
log：日志场景
parameters.name: usage_scenario

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. The only valid value is sharedDisk.

This extendConfigs property may appear when the planned instance type is Advanced Edition (advanced)
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，唯一取值：sharedDisk。

当规划实例类型为增强版（advanced）时，可能出现的extendConfigs属性

DiskType.description_en:
The disk type. The only valid value is CPFS_PREMIUM.

This extendConfigs property may appear when the planned instance type is Advanced Edition (advanced)
DiskType.description_zh:
磁盘类型，唯一取值：CPFS_PREMIUM。

当规划实例类型为增强版（advanced）时，可能出现的extendConfigs属性

InstanceCategory.description_en:
The edition type. Valid values:

advanced: Advanced Edition.

x-pack: Commercial Edition.

community: Community Edition
InstanceCategory.description_zh:
版本类型，取值含义如下：

advanced：增强版

x-pack：商业版

community：社区版本

DiskType.description_en:
The disk type. Valid values:

cloud_essd: ESSD.

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.

local_ssd: local SSD.

local_efficiency: local ultra disk
DiskType.description_zh:
硬盘类型，取值含义如下：

cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

cloud_ssd：SSD云盘

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘

local_ssd：本地SSD盘

local_efficiency：本地高效磁盘

Memory.description_en: The memory size of the specification for the current node role
Memory.description_zh: 当前节点角色的规格内存大小

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

WORKER: data node.

WORKER_WARM: warm node.

MASTER: dedicated master node.

KIBANA: Kibana node.

COORDINATING: client node.

ELASTIC_WORKER: elastic node
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，支持的类型如下：

WORKER：数据节点

WORKER_WARM：冷数据节点

MASTER：专有主节点

KIBANA：Kibana节点

COORDINATING：协调节点

ELASTIC_WORKER：弹性节点

OversizedCluster.description_en:
The result calculated based on capacity planning. No default value is available. Valid values:

true: The cluster is oversized. The number of data nodes calculated by capacity planning exceeds the threshold of 50.

false: The number of data nodes calculated by capacity planning is within 50
OversizedCluster.description_zh:
根据容量规划计算出来的结果，无默认值。取值含义如下：

true：代表超大集群，指容量规划计算出的数据节点数量超过阈值50。

false：容量规划计算出的数据节点数量在50以内
